Version 1.2.3 adds configurable native IR climate support to each AR01V3 receiver and consolidates local setup into one installation configurator.

**Changes in v1.2.3**

- Replaced the secrets-only helper with one interactive configurator for Wi-Fi, access credentials, OTA, fallback AP and native IR climate settings.
- Preserved every existing masked password when Enter is pressed and retained unknown custom keys already present in `secrets.yaml`.
- Made configuration select one target receiver and its climate profile instead of presenting all ten receivers at once.
- Made compilation, USB, OTA, and log commands reuse and display the saved receiver without asking for its number again.
- Retained independent saved climate profiles when switching between receiver configurations, with Coolix as the compatibility default.
- Listed every supported native ESPHome IR climate platform as a numbered choice in a compact three-column menu, without requiring technical identifiers.
- Added standard Fujitsu General and vertical-vane-only Fujitsu profiles for compatible Fuji Electric and Fujitsu General air conditioners.
- Added a separate stateless **SET** button to the vertical-vane-only Fujitsu profile for advancing the vane by one physical step.
- Allowed the native climate entity to be disabled completely when it is not used.
- Published climate control as a separate Home Assistant device named after the selected brand, such as **Fujitsu** or **Coolix**, with the standard air-conditioner icon.
- Grouped native climate control and the optional **SET** button in a separate brand-named device web-interface section without redundant sub-device prefixes.
- Added the installed project firmware version to device web-interface diagnostics without creating another Home Assistant entity.
- Applied the selected profiles consistently during validation, compilation, USB or OTA upload, and log access.
- Updated the English and Polish documentation for native climate generation, original-remote reception and the limits of one-way IR state tracking.

**Upgrade notes**

- Existing installations continue to compile with Coolix until another profile is selected.
- Native climate commands are generated by ESPHome and do not consume persistent IR slots.
- A normal firmware update preserves paired ESP-RC01 remotes, autonomous assignments, stored RF/IR slots and an existing NightmatIQ configuration.
